note_id.description: hash key; opaque slug or uuid

version_ts.description: range key; <ms-epoch>-<4-digit-suffix> for tie-breaking on writes within the same millisecond. lambda-assigned, not caller-supplied

content.description: the note's text, as a TEMPLATE: `$1`/`$2` stand where a firm-specific value goes and `private_values` carries those values in order. PUBLIC BY CONSTRUCTION — a note is where someone writes 'call Dana about the late invoice', and splitting it publishes the SHAPE of the annotation (what it is about, against which invoice) while the specifics stay unserved. A writer that types a name into this field breaks the contract rather than tripping a filter

contact_id.description: FK into modules/contacts/ when this note is about a contact

journal_entry_id.description: FK into the accounting ledger when this note annotates a journal entry

purchase_order_id.description: FK into modules/purchasing/ (future) when this note is about a PO

invoice_id.description: FK into modules/invoicing/ (future) when this note is about an invoice

created_at.description: first version's ms-epoch; copied forward unchanged on subsequent versions

private_values.description: what `content`'s $1..$n stand for, in order. Never served to anyone; `template.expand(content, private_values)` reconstitutes the note for whoever holds both halves, so the owner's own view reads as written
